description: Honored Amongst the Clan It is good to see you again, <class>. I had not expected you to return. Alas, you have proven yourself a brave and honorable soldier of the Frostwolf. Your time has come again, <name>. You have earned a new ranking and as such, a new insignia denoting this rise in stature. Present your insignia. Requirements: - Frostwolf Insignia Rank 2
name: Honored Amongst the Clan
